note: Contract for grokkit workers. The last non-empty stdout line is one JSON object. Stderr is diagnostics and is not parsed. Python stdlib workers remain the core; runtime and hosts fields are optional. See references/worker_template.py. Optional language runtimes and example workers live under addons/ and are documented in docs/ADDONS.md.
stdin: Ignored unless accepts_stdin is true on the manifest (optional, unused by shipped workers).

exit_codes.1: Action failed; JSON still emitted (ok false, usually alert true).
exit_codes.3: Reserved for grokkit: host or runtime mismatch; the worker was not started.

reserved_env.GROKKIT_HOST: Optional user-defined host label (for example box, laptop, or studio). Used for placement. Any short label is accepted.
reserved_env.GROKKIT_PYTHON: Optional Python interpreter for python workers. Defaults to the interpreter running grokkit.
reserved_env.GROKKIT_DEV_ORACLE: Optional path for a private, out-of-tree dev oracle or extra checks. The kit never imports or runs it, and it is never required at runtime.

hosts.class: any (default), an OS family (linux, darwin, windows, other), or a user-defined host label. OS families are matched against the current OS. Other values are matched against GROKKIT_HOST or hosts.json.
hosts.prefer: Optional soft hint: a user-defined host label, or a list of labels. Never fails a job.
hosts.min_ram_mb: Skip starting the worker when available RAM is below this. If RAM cannot be measured, do not skip.

hosts_json: Optional file hosts.json at the kit root maps a machine hostname to a user-defined label. It is local and is not shipped. See hosts.json.example.
summary: Keep summary short and data small. Cap lists and include a total when truncated. Do not print secrets.
